title: Download validated prototypes and preserve completed jobs during upgrades
changes: Validate required-input runtime results using their canonical typed statuses; retain strict boolean checks for ordinary runtime evidence.
Preserve completed native prototypes, their exact export bytes and historical runtime evidence through versioned read-only upgrade checks.
Verify the actual app renderer dependency closure and explicit physical source origins for stopped startup checks.
Preserve old runs, receipts and retry restrictions; reject active, uncertain or conflicting work.
Keep source approvals, review, target validation, runtime checks and business acceptance separate.
limitations: The new omission route supports only the exact same-block redacted filter and ordering failure class before its reviewer starts. It does not recover hidden values or claim equivalent query behavior.

Historical review validation retains its byte-pinned implementation. Scoped reuse does not grant permission; wait allowances do not guarantee completion. Unknown outcomes require reconciliation, not automatic retry.
Server-side preparation must be configured and tested by the operator; a source release does not enable it.
This hosted preparation route accepts one FMB per request; MMB, OLB and PLL require the separate supported preparation route.
The focused prototype profile, current authority endpoint and private browser worker require explicit operator configuration and live checks.

The retained real-file run has completed OPAF review, APEX import, authenticated runtime checks and server-side SQL export on the lab target. UI download and exact-downloaded-byte fresh-ID import remain pending until the patch is deployed and exercised.
Any changed candidate requires its own independent review; a saved review is reusable only for the exact reconstructed candidate it approved.

Inert startup preservation grants no retry, execution, closure or acceptance. Mixed stages require a proven runtime candidate and one runtime target; not every unresolved boundary is supported. Actual host compatibility and coherent deployment remain separate gates.
A recorded validation continuation that returns to ATTENTION still requires operator reconciliation; refreshing the page does not restart it.
Technical identifiers are retained; redaction receipts are not complete PII certification or processing permission.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate. A prototype export does not prove clean-schema reimport, customer-target compatibility or business equivalence.

Fresh-project isolation requires the supported single-converter process and a genuinely new project. It does not attest arbitrary manual processes, authorize old retries or prove a completed conversion.
